newsitem.title: GERMANY: Oil World ups EU oilseed crop data, cuts Canada's.
newsitem.headline: Oil World ups EU oilseed crop data, cuts Canada's.

text.p: The weekly Oil World newsletter on Tuesday raised an earlier forecast for the European Union's oilseed crops in 1997/98 while reducing a forecast for Canada's 1997/98 rapeseed (canola) output.
Combined oilseed output in the EU was now pegged at 13.61 million tonnes compared with 11.99 million in 1996/97 and a forecast of 13.45 million for 1997/98 a fortnight ago.
The publication cited record yields and volumes in France and larger crops in Italy and Germany, which more than offset specific downward revisions in Spanish sunseed and German rapeseed.
The EU's 1997/98 rapeseed output was put at 8.23 million tonnes (7.15 million 1996/97), sunseed at 4.06 million (3.84) and soybeans at 1.32 million (1.00).
Canadian canola production (Aug/July 1997/98) could total 6.20 million tonnes versus a July 22 forecast for 6.7-6.9 million tonnes and the previous season's 5.04 million, Oil World added.
It cited dry conditions over the past four weeks and looming frost threats, which could depress yields.
Canola exports in 1997/98 were seen lower at 2.50 million tonnes (2.57 million in 1996/97), due to lower shipments to the U.S. and EU, but crushings up at 3.13 million (2.73 million).
